producer_report.summary: I moved the boundary word scan and plain-text rewrite out of briefs.rs into a new `briefs/boundary.rs` submodule. That is about 257 lines, from `boundary_words` through `plain_boundary_text`, with `BOUNDARY_SCAN_INSTRUCTION` and `banned_words_section` included. briefs.rs declares `mod boundary;` and re-exports the public names, so `athena_context::briefs::` paths are unchanged. The only code change is that `banned_words_section` is now `pub(super)`. `MIRROR_CHECK_INSTRUCTION` and `mirror_check_section` stay in briefs.rs, since they are a separate note. I added a Changed entry to CHANGELOG.md. The 102 briefs tests and the policy scan (17 tests) pass. I did not run clippy or the full workspace test, and I did not run the code-health tool, so the new line count is an estimate.
